game.name: DigiScreen-Stream
game.desc: DigiScreen plus the FatmaVision screen stream: mirrors an Elektron Digitone / Digitakt / Syntakt screen on the handheld while streaming the handheld's display (fb0 -> H.264 tcp:5555) so the FatmaVision app can watch remotely. The stream starts first, then DigiScreen; the stream stops when DigiScreen exits.\n\nRuns inside the vaixterm terminal emulator with a full gptokeyb gamepad control layer. Requires the DigiScreen port and an Elektron Digitone / Digitakt / Syntakt connected by USB-MIDI. Exit with the EmulationStation hotkey.
